fields.description: How the Biometric / Attendance Device ID (attendance_device_id) is assigned on an Employee. Manual: HR types it. Hybrid: HR may type it or click Generate. Auto (Compulsory): the system assigns the next free number on save and the field is read-only for non-System-Managers. The ID is unique and gap-filled (555, 557 present -> 556); once set, only a System Manager can change it.

fields.description: Treat multiple check-ins for the same employee within this many minutes as one accidental repeat punch (biometric double-taps), ignoring the extras when computing status and working hours. All raw logs stay linked to the attendance. Note: a day still needs at least two distinct punches (an in and an out) to be marked Present — a single punch always stays Absent. Set 0 to disable de-duplication.
fields.label: Ignore Repeat Check-ins Within (Minutes)

fields.description: Attendance Requests and Attendance changes dated more than this many months in the past can only be submitted by the role below. Set 0 to disable the restriction.
fields.label: Require Master Approval for Attendance Older Than (Months)

fields.description: Only users holding this role may submit attendance dated beyond the months threshold above (Administrator always can).
fields.label: Role Allowed to Approve Back-dated Attendance
Unlink Payment on Cancellation of Employee Advance

fields.description: When ON, activating an employee auto-creates a Leave Policy Assignment from the company's Default Leave Policy / Leave Period (which cascades into Leave Allocations). Idempotent and opt-in.
fields.label: Auto-assign Leave Policy on Employee Activation
Task Scheduler & Lifecycle
fields.description: Controls how HRMS Task templates instantiate daily Task Instances (Goals with goal_type='Task Instance') and how completed instances are archived.

fields.label: Task Scheduler Lookahead (days)
fields.description: How many days in advance the daily scheduler should pre-create Task Instances. 0 = today only; 1 = today + tomorrow. Default 1.

fields.label: Auto-archive Completed Task Instances After (days)
fields.description: Completed Task Instances older than this many days are moved to 'Archived' status by the daily housekeeping scheduler. 0 disables archival.

fields.label: Show Overdue Task Popup on Login
fields.description: When enabled, employees with overdue Task Instances see a Desk popup at app_ready.

fields.label: Send Overdue Task HR Digest (daily)
fields.description: When enabled, the daily overdue-task scheduler emails a per-Company digest to users holding the role below.

fields.label: Task Overdue Digest Recipients Role
fields.description: Users holding this role receive the daily overdue-task digest. Default: HR Manager.

fields.label: Task Compliance Report Thresholds
fields.description: Colour thresholds for the Task Compliance report. Compliance % at or above 'Warning' shows green; between 'Critical' and 'Warning' shows yellow; below 'Critical' shows red.

fields.label: Auto-populate KRA Performance on Appraisal Save
fields.description: When enabled, the Appraisal form's KRA Performance HTML is recomputed on validate from the Employee's Task Instance accumulation for the Appraisal Cycle window. Disable for appraisal cycles where you want manual override only.

fields.label: Policy Acknowledgement Defaults
fields.description: Defaults and notification behaviour for HRMS Policy / Employee Policy Acknowledgement.

fields.label: Default Acknowledgement Due (days)
fields.description: Used as a fallback when a Policy doesn't specify Acknowledgement Due (days). Default 7.

fields.label: Show Overdue Policy Popup on Login
fields.description: When enabled, employees with overdue policy acknowledgements see a Desk popup at app_ready.

fields.label: Email Employees on Policy Assignment / Overdue
fields.description: When enabled, employees are emailed (in addition to the in-app notification) when a policy is assigned to them for acknowledgement, and again when their acknowledgement becomes overdue.

fields.label: Send Overdue Policy HR Digest (daily)
fields.description: When enabled, the daily overdue-policy scheduler emails a per-Company digest to users holding the role below.

fields.label: Policy Overdue Digest Recipients Role
fields.description: Users holding this role receive the daily overdue-policy digest. Default: HR Manager.

fields.label: Probation Defaults
fields.description: Defaults applied when an Employee is created on Probation, and the lookahead window for daily Probation Review reminder ToDos.

fields.label: Default Probation Period (days)
fields.description: When a new Employee is created with confirmation_status='Probation' and no Scheduled Confirmation Date, it is auto-set to date_of_joining + this many days. Typical: 180 (6 months).

fields.label: Probation Review Reminder Window (days)
fields.description: Daily scheduler creates Probation Review reminder ToDos for Employees whose Scheduled Confirmation Date falls within this many days from today. Default 30.

fields.label: Notice Period Recovery / Pay-in-Lieu
fields.description: Drives the FnF notice math: per-day rate × notice balance. Used in receivables (Short Notice) or payables (Pay in Lieu).

fields.label: Notice Recovery Basis
fields.description: Component(s) from the last Salary Slip used to compute the per-day rate. Default: Basic Only.

fields.label: Days in Month (divisor)
fields.description: Divisor for per-day rate. 30 is the common contractual standard; 26 / actual calendar days are alternatives.

fields.label: Allow Negotiated Waiver / Override
fields.description: When ticked, the negotiated_waiver_amount field on FnF overrides the auto-computed Notice Balance Amount on the resulting line. Useful for negotiated settlements.

fields.label: F&F Auto-payables and TDS
fields.description: When on, FnF.validate auto-creates the relevant downstream documents and adds the corresponding lines to FnF.

fields.label: Auto-create Gratuity on FnF
fields.description: When tenure ≥ Gratuity Rule's minimum years AND no Gratuity exists for the Employee, FnF.validate creates a Gratuity draft using the Company's Gratuity Rule (or the first one found) and adds a payables line.

fields.label: Auto-create Leave Encashment on FnF
fields.description: For each Leave Type with allow_encashment=1 that has a balance for the Employee, FnF.validate creates a Leave Encashment draft and adds a payables line.

fields.label: Compute TDS on Final Settlement
fields.description: FnF.validate computes projected_annual_tax via Income Tax Slab applied to (YTD gross + FnF taxable payables) − YTD TDS deducted. Adds a 'TDS on Final Settlement' line to receivables. Skipped silently when no slab applies.

fields.label: Auto-generate Exit Letters on FnF Submit
fields.description: When on, submitting an FnF automatically creates Relieving / Experience / Service Certificate drafts. When off, HR clicks the 'Generate Exit Letters' button manually.

fields.label: Default Exit Letter Letter Head
fields.description: Default Letter Head applied to exit letter PDFs.

fields.label: Form 16 Signatory Designation
fields.description: Designation printed as the authorised signatory on bulk-generated Form 16 PDFs.

fields.label: Form 16 Deadline Alert (days before Jun 15)
fields.description: Daily scheduler alerts HR when within this many days of the Form 16 issuance deadline (June 15 each year).

fields.label: Grievance SLA (by Severity)
fields.description: Default SLA days per severity, used when the Grievance Type doesn't specify default_sla_days. Days are computed from raised_date.

fields.label: POSH
fields.description: POSH complaint detail visibility is enforced by permission_query_conditions and is NOT controlled by HR Settings. These knobs only affect SLA + alerts.

fields.label: Statutory SLA (days)
fields.description: Sec 11 of POSH Act 2013 mandates 90 days. Editable for jurisdictions that adopt different timelines — change with legal advice.

fields.label: POSH IC Alert Role
fields.description: Role notified when the IC for a Company is missing or has fewer than 4 active members (informational — not enforced).

fields.label: Annual Report Alert (days before FY end)
fields.description: HR is reminded to file the POSH Annual Report (Sec 21) this many days before fiscal year end.

fields.label: Disciplinary Action Triggers
fields.description: Each downstream document trigger can be disabled here — useful for staged rollouts or when HR wants to keep manual control.

fields.label: Default Inquiry Duration (days)
fields.description: Informational default for inquiry duration; surfaced on the Disciplinary Action form for HR reference.

fields.label: Auto-create Resignation Request on Termination Outcome
fields.description: When ticked, Disciplinary Action with outcome=Termination/Dismissal auto-creates a Resignation Request and walks it to Pending HR Approval. When unticked, HR must initiate the RR manually.

fields.label: Auto-create Warning Letter on Warning Outcomes
fields.description: When ticked, Written / Final Warning outcomes auto-create an Appointment Letter draft using the Warning Letter Template.

fields.label: Auto-create Salary Withholding on Suspension
fields.description: When ticked, Suspension outcomes auto-create a Salary Withholding for the suspension period. Requires the Employee to have an active Salary Structure Assignment.

fields.label: Wage Code Enforcement
fields.description: Wage Code §2(y) (live since 21 Nov 2025) requires Basic + DA + Retaining Allowance ≥ 50% of total wages.

fields.label: Wage Code Enforcement
fields.description: HARD blocks save; WARN only msgprints; OFF skips the check.

fields.label: Basic + DA Minimum %
fields.description: Floor for Basic + DA as % of total earnings.

fields.label: PF Wage Ceiling
fields.description: EPS / EDLI capped at this monthly wage (₹15,000 in 2026).

fields.label: PF Admin Charges Minimum
fields.description: Per-establishment per-month minimum (₹500 in 2026).

fields.label: PF Headcount Threshold
fields.description: Company headcount at which PF becomes mandatory (20 by EPF Act).

fields.label: ESI Wage Ceiling
fields.description: Monthly gross at or below which ESI applies (₹21,000 standard).

fields.label: ESI Employee Daily Wage Waiver
fields.description: Employee ESI share is waived when daily wage is at or below this amount.

fields.label: PAN Mandatory Above Annual Income
fields.description: Below this annual income (monthly base × 12) a missing PAN is a non-blocking warning — no TDS / Form 16 arises. At or above it, a missing PAN hard-blocks the Salary Structure Assignment. Set to 0 to make PAN mandatory for everyone.

fields.label: Enforce Minimum Wage Validation
fields.description: Validator checks structure gross against state Minimum Wage Notification per designation_category.

fields.label: Default PT State
fields.description: Fallback state for employees whose address has no resolvable state.

fields.label: Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP)
fields.description: Forward-looking — DPDP Rules 2026 implementation.

fields.label: Require Aadhaar Consent Record
fields.description: When ticked, the validator emits an INFO when an Employee has a full Aadhaar number stored without a consent record.

fields.label: Data Retention (years)
fields.description: Default retention period for ex-employee personal data after relieving (typical 7-8 years for IT Act and Companies Act compliance).

fields.options: Re-applies this app's India-law-aligned HR defaults as of today: statutory HR Settings (PF/ESI, Professional Tax, Labour Codes, exit/gratuity), Indian States & PT slabs, and the default notification templates. Safe and idempotent.

fields.label: Apply Indian Statutory Defaults (as of Today)

fields.options: Hard-sets the governance controls below to their recommended (ON) state: leave/expense approver mandatory, restrict back-dated leave, prevent self-approval of leaves & expense claims, and auto-assign leave policy on activation. Use to enforce a compliant baseline.
Uses the AI Interface app to analyse this organisation's HR configuration against current Indian labour law, surfacing compliance gaps and employee-retention suggestions. Results are written below.

fields.label: DPDP: Enable Access Logging
fields.description: Master kill-switch for the DPDP Access Logger. When OFF, sensitive-field-access logging is bypassed entirely. Useful for disabling during bulk operations or load tests.

fields.label: DPDP: Access Log Throttle (Seconds)
fields.description: Minimum seconds between identical access log entries for (user × doctype × record × field). Prevents log floods on repeated form refreshes. Default 3600 (1 hour).

fields.label: DPDP: Purge Max Records Per Run
fields.description: Hard cap on records the weekly retention purge scheduler processes in one run. Safety bound against runaway purges from a misconfigured Data Retention Rule. Default 50.

fields.label: DPDP: Breach Notification Role
fields.description: Role whose holders receive PWA breach-notification alerts. The DPB (Data Protection Board) notification is separate.

fields.label: Employee Consent Text Version
fields.description: Snapshotted on every Onboarding Application and Profile Change Request at submission time. Bump when the consent wording materially changes; existing records remain pinned to the version under which they were captured.

fields.label: Self-Editable Employee Fields
fields.description: One Employee fieldname per line. Employees can request changes to these fields via the PWA. Blank lines and lines starting with '#' are ignored. Leave blank to use the built-in defaults.

fields.label: Onboarding: Invite Link Validity (Days)
fields.description: How many days an Employee Onboarding invite link stays valid once generated. Tokens are HMAC-signed with this expiry baked in so a leaked link self-disables. Default 30.

fields.label: Onboarding: Minimum Employment Age
fields.description: Hard lock on the Employee Onboarding Application: candidates with a DOB implying age below this number are blocked. Default 14 (Child Labour (Prohibition and Regulation) Act, 1986). Set to 18 to enforce 'adults only' onboarding.

fields.label: PF ECR Filing Window (Days)
fields.description: Number of days after wage month end by which PF ECR must be filed. Daily reminders fire from wage_month_end + 1 to wage_month_end + window.

fields.label: PF ECR: Skip Employees Missing UAN
fields.description: When ON, employees without a UAN are skipped (logged in Exceptions). When OFF, ECR generation throws — useful in strict environments where missing UAN must be fixed before filing.

fields.label: PF EDLI Per-Member Cap (₹)
fields.description: Per-member EDLI contribution cap. Computed as EDLI wage cap × 0.50% (15,000 × 0.005 = 75). Set higher only if Notification 2024-XX raises it.

fields.label: ESI Filing Window (Days)
fields.description: Number of days after wage month end by which ESI contribution must be filed.

fields.label: Form 24Q Filing Window (Days)
fields.description: Days BEFORE the statutory Form 24Q due date by which to start nagging HR Managers. Reminders continue for this many days AFTER the due date too. Q1 due 31 Jul, Q2 due 31 Oct, Q3 due 31 Jan, Q4 due 31 May.

fields.label: PT Filing Window (Days)
fields.description: Days after the PT filing period closes (monthly / half-yearly per state) within which to nag for an unfiled PT Return.

fields.label: LWF Filing Window (Days)
fields.description: Days after the LWF filing period closes within which to nag for an unfiled LWF Return.

fields.label: Default Responsible-Person Designation (Form 24Q)
fields.description: Pre-fills the 'Person Responsible for Deduction' designation on new TDS Return Form 24Q docs (e.g., 'Director - Finance' or 'CFO'). HR can override per return.

fields.label: Compliance Calendar Upcoming Days
fields.description: Days ahead of the due date to start nagging the responsible person about an upcoming compliance filing.

fields.label: Compliance Calendar Escalation Days After Due
fields.description: Number of days past the due date after which to escalate to HR Manager.

fields.label: Send Compliance Calendar Daily Digest
fields.description: Send a per-Company HTML digest email of upcoming + overdue filings to the HR Manager role each day.

fields.label: Compliance Calendar Digest Recipients Role
fields.description: Role whose users receive the digest + escalation alerts.

fields.label: Auto-link Filings to Calendar
fields.description: When a PF ECR / ESI / 24Q / PT / LWF / Form 16 / POSH Annual Report saves, automatically find + back-link its Compliance Filing row.

fields.label: Standing Orders Threshold (Workers)
fields.description: IR Code §28 — Standing Orders mandatory at this worker count.

fields.label: Works Committee Threshold (Workers)
fields.description: IR Code §3 — Works Committee mandatory at this worker count.

fields.label: GRC Threshold (Workers)
fields.description: IR Code §4 — Grievance Redressal Committee mandatory at this worker count.

fields.label: Safety Committee Threshold (Workers)
fields.description: OSH&WC §96 — Safety Committee mandatory at this worker count.

fields.label: POSH IC Threshold (Workers)
fields.description: POSH Act §4 — Internal Committee mandatory at this worker count.

fields.label: Enable UAN Aadhaar Validation
fields.description: Warn on Employee.validate when UAN is set but not seeded with Aadhaar (SS Code §142).

fields.label: Enable Monthly Labour Code Compliance Check
fields.description: Monthly scheduler — compare worker count vs thresholds; notify HR Manager on gaps.
